definition.name: suite1-reborn-main-7e08c920-stock
definition.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: the owner asked for the full suite now on the current state of main (borg-zoo#183): Suite 1 on borg-reborn-rs main 7e08c920 with its own default settings, all stages to full 999.
definition.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#183). A sanity check of main: the 999 saves of
Suite 1 with its protocol (exact 2,000-engine-turn horizon, 5-second native wall limit, fresh Borg
memory, saved engine RNG). Settings: the checkout's own harness/borg.txt (sha256 04dd52f7...), nothing
overridden, no plan because the file names none. Stages smoke 18, small 90, medium 360, big 900 and full
999 run in sequence on the owner's single go, without replays. A stage that fails its gate stops the
sequence. Gate at every stage: no missing, invalid or stopped cell; one binary; every cell's native
receipts show the save, the RNG, the borg-rs core, every borg.txt setting written, every borg_param_*
effective from borg.txt, no plan loaded, and an initial pack/equipment/rune hash equal to the suite's.
Reported alone: the death share, deaths per class and every scenario's outcome. Encounters from one life
are correlated.
definition.question: How does borg-reborn-rs main 7e08c920, with its own default settings, play the 999 saved encounters of Suite 1?
